name: Naeyeoreum Naekkum
source: Kicked out of the band overnight, I lost my colleagues, my place to go, and my instruments. To keep making music, I returned to the old practice room where I used to play. There, I ran into my childhood friend Jeong Su-hee. But... did she always sing this well? Maybe we could start a band again after all?
translation: 一夜之间我被赶出了乐队，失去了同事、去处和乐器。为了继续创作音乐，我回到了以前演奏的旧练习室。在那里，我遇到了儿时好友郑秀熙。可是……她唱歌一直都这么好听吗？也许我们可以再次组建乐队？
